newsitem.title: USA: Bay of Bengal cyclone strengthening, to hit India.
newsitem.headline: Bay of Bengal cyclone strengthening, to hit India.

text.p: Tropical Cyclone 08B in the Bay of Bengal has top winds near 50 mph, expected to increase to near 60-65 mph in the next 24-36 hours as the storm turns northwest and makes landfall over east central India toward the end of that time, Weather Services Corp said.

The cyclone is currently near 13N/84E, moving north northwest at 8 mph. This system threatens to bring flooding rain to areas that were hit by Tropical Cyclone 07B a few weeks ago. But winds should not be as damaging, WSC added.
